create_parser_instance: create a Parser instance that manages multiple argparse sub-parsers in an OrderedDict
add_parser_method: add a named argparse sub-parser to the Parser using the add_parser method
parse_args: parse sys.argv through all registered sub-parsers and return a dictionary of parsed args
log_parsers: log all registered arg_parsers to stdout using the Parser log method
review_parser_class: review the Parser class that orchestrates multiple argparse sub-parsers with parse_known_args
